cards.title: Closed home still bookable
cards.description: A guest can reach checkout for Beach House even though it is closed. Confirm the expected behavior for existing reservations and new checkouts.

cards.title: Listings page is slow
cards.description: Broad searches take noticeably longer than the rest of the app. Keep timings and matching result IDs for each change.

cards.title: Minimum stay by date: hosts want it for holidays starting November 16
cards.description: Hosts want a booking-length rule for the holiday period. Every stay already needs at least three nights, on every home and date (PR #3; GLOSSARY.md, Minimum stay), so a holiday rule only matters above three. Confirm the number of nights, affected homes, effective date, and treatment of existing reservations before implementation.
cards.waitingOn: Product decisions about a holiday rule above three nights and existing reservations

cards.title: Calendar feels slow with many homes
cards.description: Moving through the large host calendar feels uneven while request logs do not show a corresponding problem. Capture the interaction and inspect the browser.

cards.title: Give incoming support a clear destination
cards.description: The inbox needs a consistent set of categories and an accountable owner for each incoming request. Agree on the categories with support first.

cards.title: Review refund amount when check-in is five days away
cards.description: A guest expected a different refund for a moderate-policy reservation. Reproduce the amount at the stated date before changing pricing or copy.

cards.title: Refresh quick-start instructions
cards.description: The setup instructions need to agree with the commands and server startup output. Check the README and runbook from a clean checkout.

cards.title: Reserve a home with demo payment
cards.description: Guest details, a clear price breakdown, a local confirmation, and a reservation in Your trips.

cards.title: Export host payout history
cards.description: Hosts can download the same payout records they see in their workspace.

cards.title: Fit host date controls on a phone
cards.description: The calendar block form should fit a 390px viewport without making the page scroll sideways.

cards.title: Keep feedback with its page context
cards.description: Every page has a small feedback form. Store the page, application time, rating, and message.

cards.title: Review rating order on search results
cards.description: The rating branch does not pass the existing highest-first ordering check. Review the displayed order and the assertion before merging.

cards.title: Holiday surcharge on each host's holiday nights
cards.description: Split from the holiday card on 2026-11-19; decisions in docs/decisions/0003-holiday-pricing-and-refunds.md. Hosts set holiday dates, a surcharge of 1 to 50% and refund days (1 to 60) per listing, all three or none. A holiday night is the night starting on a holiday date; its surcharge is the percentage of that night's own price, rounded per night, inside the subtotal, and the host keeps it less 3%. A partial refund never returns it or its tax. Saved on the reservation; later edits don't reach it.

cards.title: Free cancellation through the business day after reserving
cards.description: Split from the holiday card on 2026-11-19, where it was a "24-hour hold"; decisions in docs/decisions/0003-holiday-pricing-and-refunds.md. Every new reservation can be cancelled for a full refund, service fee included, whatever the policy, on the day it is made and the next business date. Reservations made before it have no period.

cards.title: Holiday refund window set by the host
cards.description: Split from the holiday card on 2026-11-19; decisions in docs/decisions/0003-holiday-pricing-and-refunds.md. A holiday stay gets a full refund when cancelled at least the host's number of days before check-in; the guest gets whichever of that and the listing's policy refunds more, so the window only adds to refunds. Pending requests keep their full refund. Saved on the reservation.
